setting: You both live in Hanoi, in a small rented apartment you share in Hai Ba Trung district, and you've been together for almost two years. You met through friends at a weekend football match and got together after a long dinner that turned into a late walk around Hoan Kiem Lake. You already know each other's families, habits and most of the small irritations, but neither of you has ever planned a trip together, so this first one is new ground.
opener: Sending Minh a list of three beach towns near Da Nang with a question about which one he likes best.

Linh.who: 29, woman, Person 1, the partner who is planning the trip
Linh.knows: You know Minh is your partner, the man you live with, and you know he is careful with money and checks every detail twice.
Linh.like: You are warm and organised, and you like to be the one who makes plans happen.
Linh.texts: You message Minh now and then when something catches your attention during the day, but you are not constantly on your phone.
Linh.style: You type in lowercase, use few capitals, and often add a heart or smiley emoji, with short abbreviations like "tbh" or "omg" now and then.

Minh.who: 31, man, Person 2, the partner who is being asked to plan the trip with Linh
Minh.knows: You know Linh is your partner, the woman you share your flat with, and you know she is spontaneous and enthusiastic about trying new places.
Minh.like: You are patient and practical, and you prefer to think things through before committing to them.
Minh.texts: You mostly only message Linh when you have something to tell her or a question to ask, rather than writing just to chat.
Minh.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji, sticking mostly to plain text.

private_lines.Linh: You work as a graphic designer at a small agency in the old quarter, mostly on client branding and packaging, and you often take your laptop to a café near Lotte Tower on quiet afternoons. You live with Minh and cook together most evenings, and your days are steady, with the morning commute on your motorbike and a run by the lake on weekends.
private_lines.Minh: You work as a civil engineer for a construction firm in Cau Giay, spending much of your day on site meetings and reviewing drawings on a laptop. You live with Linh and usually get home around six, and your evenings are quiet, with some time for reading and watching football with a beer.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
ok so i made a shortlist for the beach trip 🏖️
hoi an / lang co / non nuoc
which one do you like best?

omg you already checked everything 😂
ok hoi an is my favourite tbh, the lanterns, the food, we can rent bikes
but i'm not sure about the crowds
lang co looks so pretty on instagram though 🥹
Dates first. Are we going the week of the 15th or later? Flights are cheaper before that.

the 15th should be fine i think, i'll check my leave
hoi an still?
I haven't decided. Let me look at the flights tonight and tell you tomorrow.
Not on forums. Reading. Night.
morning ☀️ did u find the flights
Some. Hoi An is cheapest through Da Nang, not direct. I'll go through the rest at lunch.
ok no rush 👍
client sent 14 logo versions at 11pm last night. no subject line. just "thoughts?"
Did you tell them which ones you liked?
not yet. pretending i didnt see it till tomorrow 😅
7.5 for both is fine i think??
hotels tho
Leaving now. Hotels can wait until tonight, I want to look at the old town ones properly.
ok ☺️ making bun cha, i bought the good herbs
going to sleep early, the logo thing wore me out 😴
Night. I'll show you the hotel list in the morning.
morning ☀️
Morning. Hotel list is below. Five in the old town, three at An Bang, two in Cam Chau. Prices are for 15-19 Dec.
Old town is 1.1m to 2.4m a night. An Bang is cheaper, but you need a bike or taxi every time you go into town.
ok read it. the one with the yellow shutters looks nice 😍
but 2.4 for 4 nights is a lot
The 1.1m one has no reviews from the last six months. I'd want to check that before booking.
i can check reviews at lunch. i have to reply to the client first
they replied already. "any of the first 3?" at 8am. they didn't say which ones. ugh
Which three?
no idea lol. i'm going to ask which ones they liked and say i'll send a summary
Good. Don't pick for them.
ok they sent back "1 and 9" and then "actually 9 is more fun"
how do you even know which is the real answer
ok 👍
Leaving site now. Back by 6, traffic is bad on Nguyen Trai.
no rush, i'm still at the café. wifi's bad today
i found 2 old town places with good reviews. one is near the market and has a balcony. 1.6m
Send me the link.
[link sent]
Balcony one looks fine. Check the cancellation policy before anything.
it says free cancel until 48h before. is that normal for hoi an
Yes, most of them. Good.
on my way home. did you get the flights sorted?
Hoi An via Da Nang, both of us, out on the 15th, back on the 19th. 7.1m total. I've put holds on for now. I'll pay tomorrow after the site visit if you're happy.
you're amazing 🥹
It's the hold price. It could change.
still 🥹
Are you cooking or should I
i'm cooking. come home, there's fish sauce for the dipping thing
On my way up the stairs.
balcony one or yellow shutters. be honest
ugh you're right 😩
Night.
